description: Implementation of socket operations for POSIX systems within the Chromium network stack, including socket creation, connection, acceptance, reading, writing, and error handling.

classes.name: SocketPosix
classes.description: A class implementing POSIX socket operations for network communication, including connection management, data transfer, and event handling.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Creates and opens a socket with the specified address family.

methods.name: AdoptConnectedSocket
methods.description: Adopts an existing connected socket and sets its peer address.

methods.name: ReleaseConnectedSocket
methods.description: Releases ownership of the connected socket descriptor.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a specified local address.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Marks the socket as a passive socket that will listen for incoming connections.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initiates a connection to a remote address asynchronously.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is currently connected.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if the socket is connected and has no data received.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket asynchronously.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the socket asynchronously.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of the socket.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the peer address of the socket.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket and cleans up resources.
